{"consolidated_memory":"TRUNCATED DOCUMENTS IN search/indexer/chunker.ts - FOUR SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Component: search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side), TypeScript stack
Consistent signal across all incidents: chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
Consistent repro method: index the long changelog fixture
Consistent test coverage: search/indexer/chunker.test.ts

---
INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-16]
Trigger: only on the first request after a cold start
Root cause: a mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
PR #2569 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1
Result: 51 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

INCIDENT 2 [2026-04-06]
Trigger: only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
PR #3445 on branch fix/truncated-documents-2
Result: flaky test went from 83 failures per hundred runs to zero

INCIDENT 3 [2026-07-13]
Trigger: only for clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
Root cause: the config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR #4009 on branch fix/truncated-documents-3
Result: throughput rose 95 percent, to 699 requests per second

INCIDENT 4 [2026-08-21]
Trigger: only after a rolling restart of the fleet
Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
PR #5078 on branch fix/truncated-documents-4
Result: job finished in 65 minutes instead of 8 hours"}
